notes:
- Automatic lock when the computer is left idle: first the screen locks and your page is kept (unlock with your password), then the database closes, and finally the program quits — each after its own idle time
- The status bar shows a live countdown to the next automatic lock; click it to lock right away
- Backups: several backups taken on the same day are reduced to that day's latest, and the newest 30 are kept
- The screen shown when a copy cannot be opened here now has buttons to set up from scratch or to restore from a backup
- Step-by-step help with its own screenshots, in every language (press F1)
- Fixed: some setup forms did not scroll and the step did not advance
- This update is for Windows; the macOS and Linux versions stay on their current version
